messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate from edge/gateway. metric: apigw.5xx_rate spike -> 42% across eu-west-1 and us-east-1 (2026-03-17T10:23:08Z). Pager routed to @sam (oncall). Please ack with status.

sam (oncall): Acked. jumping in. triage channel created. tagging eng-infra and eng-sre.

maya: seeing steady 502/504s from 10:22:00 - 10:26:00. latency for healthchecks not great. Logs show upstream TIMEOUT in proxy pool.

 tj: +1. I see a fanout of retries to backend pool A (10.22:30) — connections saturating. conn_pool.active maxed at 96% on gw-az2-eu.

 elena: adding temporary rule: reduce edge concurrency per client to 20 for eu-west-1; applying now (will take ~30s). @ops-bot can you confirm rollout?

 ops-bot: rollout started: /configs/edge/concurrency-throttle -> eu-west-1 set 20. change-id: ch_20260317_001. Propagating to 6/6 nodes.

 sam (oncall): good. triggering partial traffic-shift fallback to replica region us-east-1 for non-critical routes. Command: `rtr fallback --from eu-west-1 --to us-east-1 --routes /api/v1/search,/api/v1/embeddings --gradual 10%`

 maya: after throttle, 5xx rate dropped to 18% in eu-west-1 within 45s. overall platform 5xx -> 25%. Still elevated but improving.

 tj: noticed some 502s correlated with backend auth service spikes. authsvc pod restarts around 10:21-10:25. opening an alert to eng-ml because they own authsvc.

 elena: @customer-success please prepare customer-facing note. initial impact: partial degradation for search & embeddings in eu-west-1; best-effort fallback to us-east-1 for non-critical routes.

 customer-success: drafting. will send short message to affected customers in EU with mitigation details and ETA.

 sam (oncall): can we confirm any customer-facing errors persisted after shift? maya?

 maya: post-shift (10:27) error rates on critical routes dropped to 6% and are trending down. tail latency still slightly high for some embedding requests.

 tj: adding circuit-breaker on proxy->authsvc to avoid retry storms. patch applied: `cb authsvc timeout 500ms threshold 5` — now enabled.

 ops-bot: config change applied: circuit-breaker authsvc -> enabled. change-id: ch_20260317_002.

 sam (oncall): ok folks, continue to monitor for 30m, keep customer-success posted. I'll coordinate postmortem if we need one. For now create an incident issue with timeline and actions.

 elena: noted. capturing timeline and metrics. I'll review kvcache and retry plumbing in follow-up.

 customer-success: update sent to customers at 10:35; flagged for SLA review if degradation > 15 min.

 incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigations: concurrency throttle + traffic shift + circuit-breaker applied. severity reduced to SEV3 at 10:32:15Z.

 sam (oncall): closing active pager. remain on-call watch for 20m. thanks all :thumbsup:
